phase3_findings.description: The _called_names docstring in src/sqllens/safety/relations.py (lines 79-80) still says each name is returned as written, lower-cased and ASCII-lower-cased, and lines 93-94 still build the ASCII-lower-cased form, but the diff deleted the only stated reason for that form (PostgreSQL's encoding-dependent folding of non-ASCII letters), so nothing now says why it is kept under MySQL.

tests/unit/test_config_schema.py has only one blank line between the module-level _ACCEPTED_URLS list (ends at line 109) and the decorated top-level test_url_scheme_accepted (line 111); PEP 8 asks for two, and Ruff's preview-only E30x rules are not enabled, so lint does not catch it.
